title: Legacy formatted writes use the untruncated length of a fixed buffer
summary: indigo_io.c:481-490: legacy indigo_printf formats into INDIGO_BUFFER_SIZE but passes vsnprintf's would-have-written length to indigo_write. Output longer than the buffer reads beyond its allocation rather than sending only produced bytes. The supported public helper differs from the correctly grown unified formatter. Next: Reject formatting errors and either grow/reformat or return a length-limit failure; exercise a format beyond the initial buffer in a synthetic local sink.
